input.quote: Ono shall have the right, in accordance with this Section 2.2, to grant sublicenses under the Array Patents and Array Know-How to its Affiliates and to Third Parties, provided that Ono shall not engage a Third Party as either (i) a Sublicensee of the Product, or (ii) as a distributor of the Product, without Array's prior written consent.
input.rationale: The grant package meets the preferred position on every material term. Array grants Ono exclusive Development and Commercialization licences (2.1(a), (c)) and a worldwide non-exclusive Manufacturing licence (2.1(b)), and our Affiliates are covered as of right — Section 2.2(a) permits sublicensing to Affiliates without consent, and 2.1(b) is expressly sublicensable to Affiliates — which is better than the fallback's "affiliates on written notice." Contractors acting on our behalf are covered: 2.1(b) expressly allows extension to Third Party manufacturers "for Manufacturing the Products on Ono's behalf," and the Subcontractor definition (1.57) and Articles IV/IX contemplate performance of activities through Subcontractors. Nothing is revocable at Array's discretion: Array can terminate only for uncured material breach (13.3, 90/60-day cure) or bankruptcy (13.4), while at-will termination rights sit with us (13.2, 13.5), and on expiry the Section 2.1 licences become "fully paid-up, irrevocable, perpetual, royalty free licenses, with sublicensing rights" (13.1). Successor transfer is satisfied by Section 18.9, which permits assignment without consent to an entity acquiring substantially all of the business or assets by merger or acquisition, with the Agreement inuring to successors and permitted assigns. Two sub-elements fall short of ideal but are not material deviations and are noted only: engaging a Third Party as Sublicensee or distributor of the Product needs Array's prior written consent, and the licences exclude any right to modify Binimetinib or Encorafenib (2.1(d)) — ordinary field limits in a pharma collaboration rather than an exclusion of affiliates/contractors with no path to add them. No redline proposed.
